kjv: will carry thee (Shebna) away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee
mine: will hurl you (Shebna) away violently, O you strong man. He (Yahweh) will seize firm hold on you
note: Hebrew metaltelkha taltelah gaber is "hurling you a hurling, O man", and 'otkha 'atoh "grasping you firmly"; the KJV's "cover" takes the wrong root.
